records.name: PLOS Computational Biology
records.scope_notes: Computational methods, software and research delivering substantial biological insight, including genomics and systems biology. Experimental validation is not mandatory; real-world data and reproducibility remain important. Strong conceptual and methodological novelty is required. OSRI fit is existing-data research, theory, simulation or methods/software; check article-type rules for reviews.

route.conditions: Important paid counterexample, not an unconditional free journal. Publication fees normally apply. Publication Fee Assistance is assessed individually, must be requested at submission, and may be partial. Research4Life Group A support requires institutional-country and funding eligibility; institutional agreements are separately conditional. A full approved waiver or applicable full-cost agreement is necessary for a zero-author-cost route.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Fee assistance may leave an author balance; optional or collection-specific charges require a manuscript-specific check.

fee_evidence.note: Publication fees are payable on acceptance. Fee assistance depends on financial need and case-by-case review; requests must be made at submission. Institutional and country programmes have eligibility conditions. This is not universal no-fee publication.
Journal instructions direct authors needing help outside participating institutions to apply for a waiver at submission.

difficulty.basis: Discovery records contribution criteria without converting them into acceptance odds; ranking agent to assess.

records.name: Bioinformatics
records.scope_notes: Computational molecular biology and genome bioinformatics, particularly algorithms and databases providing substantial advances. Relevant areas include sequence/genome analysis, phylogenetics, structural bioinformatics, gene expression and systems biology. Existing-data methods and software fit OSRI; check current article-type instructions.

route.conditions: Important paid counterexample: the journal is fully open access and has no subscription publication route. A full country-based or discretionary waiver, or a fully covering eligible institutional agreement, is needed to remove the author APC. Discretionary waivers are limited and must be sought before acceptance. Discounts alone do not make publication free.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No page or colour charges according to journal instructions; APC remains payable unless fully covered or waived. No explicit zero-submission-fee assurance established in discovery.

fee_evidence.note: Official instructions identify a fully open-access journal with APCs; describe conditional country/discretionary waivers and institutional funding; and explicitly state no page or colour charges. Waivers are not acceptance guarantees.
OUP offers a discretionary waiver application outside its eligible country schemes; applying does not establish that a full waiver will be granted.

difficulty.basis: Discovery has not collected official acceptance statistics or assigned a difficulty band.

notes: Ten journals: eight candidate subscription/no-APC routes and two influential fully OA conditional-waiver counterexamples. No journal is labelled verified_free by discovery because explicit zero-submission/all-compulsory-cost evidence was not established. Fee and ranking agents must independently assess these records.

Scope is existing-data analysis, theoretical and mathematical biology, bioinformatics methods/software and simulation. No new physical laboratory work or clinical practice is proposed. Scope fit does not certify scientific validity or acceptance.
Springer-heavy selection reflects accessible, journal-specific no-APC evidence; diamond/open expansion should diversify publishers and include community/society venues.

Additional Elsevier leads investigated but not added as records because ScienceDirect author guides returned 403: Mathematical Biosciences (https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/mathematical-biosciences/publish/guide-for-authors), Theoretical Population Biology (https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/theoretical-population-biology/publish/guide-for-authors), Computational Biology and Chemistry (https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/computational-biology-and-chemistry/publish/guide-for-authors). Current official Elsevier Shop pages established scope and subscription access, but did not establish all author charges. Do not infer free submission/publication from reader subscription status.

No impact factors, acceptance rates, processing times, indexing claims or APC amounts were transcribed. Missing quantitative evidence remains missing. Peer-review labelling refers to research routes; not every commentary or editorial is necessarily externally peer reviewed.
Checked official journal scope, publishing and guideline pages live on the stated date. Independent automated/agent review does not substitute for human manuscript or scientific review.
